name: halftone-dots-round-and-square
description: Animated WebGL shader background in the Halftone Dots style. Round and square variant. Generated by the 21st.dev Shader Builder. Adapted from Paper Shaders under Apache-2.0. 4-color palette (#D4D4D4, #525252, #111111, #FAFAFA). Features: high intensity. A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections and animated gradient/noise backgrounds.
